body: Objective: Fix FOUC (flash of unstyled content) on nav transitions + fix cert image issues from code review. Context: Two separate issues to fix in this task. ## FIX 1: FOUC on view transitions Root cause: Astro ClientRouter view transitions cause white flash during page swap. Dark bg (#0a0a0a) only in external CSS (global.css), no inline fallback on . Browser paints white during transition gap. Fix: Add inline dark background to `` element in src/layouts/Layout.astro (currently line ~47: ``). Change to: `` This covers the transition gap and also kills flash on slow first load. ## FIX 2: Cert image issues from review File: src/pages/cv/index.astro, Certifications section (around lines 275-290). Issues to fix: 1. **Missing width/height** on cert `` tags → CLS on 715KB images. Images are 1650×1275. Add `width="1650" height="1275"` to each ``. 2. **Missing `decoding="async"`** — project convention on all images. Add `decoding="async"`. 3. **Alt text duplicates heading** → screen readers read title twice. Change `alt={cert.title}` to `alt=""` (empty, since the title follows immediately in the heading below). 4. **Image sizing** — `max-w-md w-full` caps at 448px in ~672px card → awkward empty space. Change to full card width: remove `max-w-md`, keep `w-full`. Image should fill card width with `rounded-lg border border-border`. 5. **Link hover** — add `transition-colors hover:text-accent` to the "Verify on Coursera" link for consistency with other hover states on page. 6. **Arrow char** — "Verify on Coursera →" uses arrow char not used elsewhere. Drop the arrow, just "Verify on Coursera" is fine. Constraints: - Do NOT change dates — those are verified correct - Do NOT touch JSON-LD schema - Preserve all existing content and sections - Tailwind v4 conventions Deliverables: - Confirm FOUC fix applied (inline bg on ) - Confirm all 6 cert image issues fixed - Run `pnpm build` to verify clean build Prerequisites: Read src/layouts/Layout.astro and src/pages/cv/index.astro before editing.
